solution.title: GPO Rationalization & Cleanup with Group Policy Analytics

products.name: GPO Rationalization & Cleanup with Group Policy Analytics — Commercial
products.short_description: The foundational GPO cleanup before any Intune migration — inventory, rationalize with Group Policy analytics, retire the dead, document intent, and produce a sequenced migration backlog. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
products.description:
Clean up the GPO mess before you migrate — so the move to Intune is built on solid ground

Years of Group Policy leave a thicket: nested and redundant policies, duplicate audit settings, and unclear intent that nobody fully understands. Migrating that mess to Intune as-is just moves the chaos. This solution is the foundational cleanup — inventory every GPO, use Intune Group Policy analytics to rationalize and de-duplicate, retire what's dead, document intent, and produce a clean, sequenced migration backlog — so the move to a modern Intune baseline starts from order, not sprawl.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — why rationalize before migrating, how Intune Group Policy analytics scores migration readiness, and the de-duplication / retire / consolidate / document workflow.
  • Requirements Guide — every prerequisite (access to export GPOs, Intune with Group Policy analytics, Entra ID, a rationalization owner) with how to verify and how to implement each if missing.
  • Implementation Guide — exact, ordered steps: export and inventory all GPOs, import to Group Policy analytics, classify (keep / retire / consolidate / replace), resolve redundant audit and conflicting policies, document intent, and produce a sequenced migration backlog, then pilot and expand.
  • 5 PowerShell scripts — GPO export/inventory discovery, rationalization-coverage validation, a redundancy/conflict and readiness report, safe remediation of dead/duplicate links, and a migration-backlog/scope builder.
  • Testing & Troubleshooting Guides with explicit pass/fail gates, plus field-proven Best Practices for the assign-once, repeat-everywhere model.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

A clean, rationalized GPO estate with a documented, sequenced migration backlog — the dead and duplicate policies gone and intent captured — so the Intune migration is built on solid ground, proven on a pilot scope before you scale.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • GPORAT-Discovery.ps1 — export and inventory every Group Policy Object for rationalization
    • GPORAT-Remediation.ps1 — safely unlink/remove the dead and duplicate GPOs (-WhatIf default)
    • GPORAT-Report.ps1 — redundancy / conflict + migration-readiness report
    • GPORAT-Set-MigrationBacklogTargeting.ps1 — build the sequenced backlog + Entra scope groups
    • GPORAT-Validation.ps1 — rationalization coverage check (every GPO has a disposition)

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
